headline_interpretation: The two probes are anti-correlated (score_pearson = -0.332, label_pearson = -0.346) and operate at different network depths (sensitivity L18, correctness L24). They detect opposite family populations: the sensitivity probe identifies families where distractor confusion reduces internal confidence; the correctness probe identifies families the model answers reliably. CM_C_005 (correctly answered, S_lp=13.83 nats) is the key counter-example — maximal sensitivity detection, near-zero correctness-probe score — ruling out difficulty as the sole explanation.
